facts.label: Marriage license fee
facts.quote: Valid I.D. is required and the fee is $81.00.

facts.label: Marriage license fee if neither applicant shows Texas residency on ID
facts.quote: Without proof of state residency on a valid form of identification from at least one applicant the fee will be $181.00.

facts.label: Civil ceremony at a Harris County courthouse (Justice of the Peace Precinct 1, Place 1, weekday Mon-Thu slots; cash only)
Same JP court: Saturday ceremony (when available)
Same JP court: what to bring and how to pay
facts.quote: You must bring MARRIAGE LICENSE & SERVICE FEE (See above, CASH only) to office.

facts.label: Same JP court: appointments and walk-ins
facts.display: By appointment; walk-ins depend on the judge
facts.quote: Weddings are scheduled accordingly by appointments, but walk-ins are welcome based on Judge’s availability.

facts.label: Same JP court: witnesses and rings
facts.quote: Rings are not required but are OPTIONAL.

facts.label: Waiting period
facts.quote: There is a 72 hour waiting period and the license should be signed by the officiant no more than 90 days from the date of issuance.

facts.label: How long the license is valid
facts.display: 90 days from the date it is issued
facts.quote: There is a 72 hour waiting period and the license should be signed by the officiant no more than 90 days from the date of issuance.

facts.label: Waiting period waived for active military
facts.quote: The 72 hour waiting period is automatically waived for active military personnel; however you will need to present your active military ID upon the purchase of the marriage license.

facts.label: Premarital course certificate (Twogether in Texas): fee discount and no waiting period
facts.display: Up to $60 off and no 72-hour wait
facts.quote: The certificate should be presented at the time of applying for a marriage license to receive: • Up to $60 off their marriage license fee • Waiving the 72-hour waiting period

facts.label: ID you bring
facts.display: Valid government photo ID (driver's license, DPS ID, passport, resident alien card)
facts.quote: You must have a valid ID such as a driver's license, ID card issued by DPS, valid passport, resident alien card, or other U.S. government issued identification.

facts.label: How to get the license
facts.display: Both apply in person at any of 11 Harris County Clerk locations
facts.quote: Both applicants can apply for a Marriage License in person at one of our 11 locations

facts.label: Downtown Personal Records office: address and hours
facts.quote: Harris County Civil Courthouse 201 Caroline, Suite 330 Houston, TX 77002 (713) 274-8686 Hours of Operation Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM

facts.label: Witnesses at the clerk's office
facts.quote: Witnesses are not required to purchase the Marriage License nor are they required to attend the marriage ceremony.

facts.label: If either person was divorced
facts.quote: Both applicants must have been divorced 30 days before applying for a Marriage License.

facts.label: After the ceremony: return the signed license
facts.display: Return to the Clerk for recording
facts.quote: Licenses should be returned to our office for recording, after the ceremony has been performed.

steps: Both of you apply in person at a Harris County Clerk office with valid photo ID (downtown: 201 Caroline, Suite 330, Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-4:30 PM); the license costs $81, or $181 if neither ID shows Texas residency.
Wait 72 hours after the license is issued before the ceremony (waived for active military; a Twogether in Texas premarital-course certificate also waives it and takes up to $60 off the fee).

Book a courthouse ceremony with a Harris County Justice of the Peace; Precinct 1, Place 1 charges $100 on weekday slots (cash only), $200 on Saturdays when available, and takes appointments or walk-ins at the judge's availability. Bring the license and the cash.
Have the officiant sign within 90 days of the issue date, then return the signed license to the Clerk for recording (in person or by mail).
left_out: Payment methods for the marriage license itself: the Clerk page names cash / check / credit card only for assumed-name filings, not for marriage licenses.
Whether the Clerk needs an appointment for a marriage license: the page does not say; it says to apply in person at one of 11 locations.

A courthouse ceremony fee at the Clerk's office: the Clerk issues licenses only; ceremonies at courthouses are by Justices of the Peace, and only JP Precinct 1, Place 1 (Judge Eric William Carter) has a fee sheet I could read. Other JP precincts set their own fees; no official page found for them.
Date of the JP Precinct 1, Place 1 fee sheet: the PDF is undated; the JP site's own Weddings page (linked as ../info/weddings.htm) would not load from curl.
Cost of a certified copy of a ceremonial marriage license: the page's $6.00 certified-copy figure sits under the informal-marriage declaration, so it is not used.
Residency requirement wording for non-Texans: the page only gives the $181 fee when no applicant shows Texas residency; it states no other rule.

notes: Search budget ran out mid-run, so photographer and florist came from direct site probes, not searches. PHOTOGRAPHER: no Houston courthouse/city-hall 1-hour price found; Brit Fine Photography (Greater Houston, recommended by The Middleton Venue) prints micro/elopement from $1,500 for 5 hours - weak fit for a 1-hour courthouse session; a better one needs a new search. FLORIST: KVITKAFA is a Houston florist (store 15015 Westheimer Rd, Unit J, 77082); its listed bridal bouquets run $130-$230, the $130 one is Out of Stock. Lily and Olive (lilyandolive.com) was rejected: its Opal bridal bouquet at $65 is a faux-flower RENTAL and shows Sold out, fresh bouquets need a $495 minimum or a rental add-on. COURTHOUSE: license fee sources are the Clerk's own page (PersonalRecords.aspx; FAQ and main text both say $81.00, plus $181.00 with no proof of Texas residency). A 2023 press release and some blogs quoted $74 / $72 / $81: use the page, not them. The only courthouse-ceremony fee on an official page is JP Precinct 1 Place 1 (Judge Eric William Carter), $100 weekday / $200 Saturday, cash only; Harris County JPs set their own fees, so do not write it as 'the courthouse fee'. The PDF is undated. VENUES: two chapels found by domain probing (themakenziehouse.com, bookmyweddingnow.com) are the cheapest. The Makenzie House page also prints a Quick 'I Do' at $350 (its FAQ allows up to 5 guests; the page's cards are flattened in curl text, so the 30-minute detail is probably but not surely that package's) - left out of the list because price and guest count are in different sentences. Verandas Events' home page also lists Quick 'I do' $399 Elopements with no hours or guest count - left out; its pricing page text is internally inconsistent ($150 per added hour in the sentence, $100 in the Mon-Thu table row), the quote keeps both. The Reserve on Cypress Creek appears twice (elopement and micro package); Houston Botanic Garden appears twice (two different garden spaces, same 2026 PDF, 9 MB: hbg.org served it slowly during verification, so a re-run of verify_quotes may be needed if it times out; the Global Collection quote has the price line only because its guest line ('15 admission tickets included') sits in a separate bullet). Houston Arboretum (2026 rentals booklet PDF) prints Emmott Circle ceremonies for 10-75 guests at '$350-$1,200' but only as a range, and requires the renter to hold a membership - not listed. Heritage Society Bandstand $275 / 2 hours Mon-Fri has 'Capacity: Expansive' (no number) - not listed. Hermann Park Celebration Garden 'Express Rental/Proposal' $400 (35 people, 2023 fee chart) is not described as a ceremony - not listed. No The Woodlands or Sugar Land venue with a small-wedding price on its own site was found (those searches returned only directories). Venues whose own site showed no small-group price and were dropped: Bell Tower on 34th (per-guest, 'full-scale weddings'), Meekermark, Venue 116, Ella's Garden, Shirley Acres, 15 Acres, La Maison Blanc, Hotel ZaZa, The Springs, The Juliana (micro-events are showers/dinners).
